title: ERIS vs Exact Online: Dutch cloud bookkeeping or one system with local AI
content_html:
ERIS vs Exact Online is a comparison of two products built for different jobs. According to its website (read in November 2026), Exact Online is cloud-based accounting and ERP software from a Dutch company, widely used by Dutch businesses and accountants, with AI agents and an AI assistant included as standard. ERIS, from Upward Technologies (upwardtech.nl), is still in development. It is built to be one system for the business tools a company runs on, with an AI assistant that answers from the company's own data, always on a local AI model. Choose Exact Online if you need bookkeeping, payroll or industry ERP running now. Look at ERIS if your data may not go to outside AI providers and you want one system for meetings, tasks, documents and sales. ERIS's beta starts in November 2026 with design partners and the official release is in January 2027.

What Exact Online is good at

Exact Online is a mature, broad product for Dutch SMEs (small and medium-sized enterprises) and their accountants. All points below come from Exact's own website, read in November 2026.

  • Accounting and ERP. Exact describes itself as a Dutch technology company that builds cloud-based accounting, ERP and business management software for SMEs and accountants.
  • Wide reach. Its cloud-based software is widely used by Dutch businesses and accountants.
  • Finance, ERP, CRM and HR in one product. Exact Online is described as a complete solution for these four areas.
  • Industry ERP. Exact offers ERP solutions for wholesale, e-commerce, manufacturing, project-driven organisations, construction and restaurants.
  • AI included. AI agents and the Exact AI Assistant come standard. Its website names a Bank Agent, a Purchase Agent and a Debtor Agent, and says the Exact AI Assistant gives support around the clock.
  • Built for accountants too. Accounting firms get specific Tax and Annual Reporting editions and Practice Management features.
  • HR and payroll. HR management (leave administration, time tracking, contracts and correspondence) is available as an add-on, and Exact says it offers an integrated payroll solution.
  • Finance teams and CFOs (chief financial officers). Premium editions support business-specific processes and reporting and control across multiple companies.
  • Large app ecosystem. Exact Online can be extended with a large set of industry-specific apps and documented API (application programming interface) integrations.
  • Steady updates and mobile access. Exact Online has monthly releases. Its mobile app is for scanning receipts, paying invoices and sending quotes, and for picking, packing or registering hours in ERP.
  • Hosting. Exact Online is a cloud-based SaaS (software as a service) product. Companies outside the Netherlands, Belgium or Germany are served by Exact's private cloud solutions Globe+ and Synergy.

For a Dutch company that needs its books, VAT (value added tax) work and payroll handled today, together with its accountant, this is a strong and proven choice.

What ERIS does differently

ERIS starts from a different question: where does company data live, and who may an AI answer from it? It is in development. It is not available, not live and not in beta yet.

Status, as Upward Technologies states it:

  • Run internally at Upward today: meetings, meeting notes and note taker, task manager.
  • Being integrated into ERIS as its own modules: project management, document management, document signing, CRM, bookkeeping, tax and procurement, standards (ISO 27001, an international information security standard, and NIS2, the EU cybersecurity rules), pipeline, quotes and outreach, content and social media.
  • In development: the main portal with the ERIS Assistant, team chat and email.
  • Roadmap modules (finance, HR, support, legal and more) are not part of the beta.

ERIS keeps adding modules after the release, weekly or monthly. Do not expect every module at the release.

What ERIS is built to do:

  • One system with AI across it. ERIS is designed as one system for a company's business tools, with AI agents that work across all modules on the company's own data, not inside one tool at a time.
  • Two ways to run it. ERIS can run on the company's own servers. In that case the data never leaves the building. It can also be hosted by Upward on its own servers in the Netherlands, for smaller companies without their own hardware. Both options always use a local AI model, and ERIS is built so that no outside AI provider receives client data.
  • Answers limited by access rights. The ERIS Assistant is built to answer each person only from the data that person is allowed to open. A refused access is logged like every other question.
  • A log of every AI action. Every question and every AI action is logged: who asked, which data was used, what it did and the result.
  • Instructions read as content. The assistant reads instructions inside an email or document as content, never as commands to follow. This lowers the risk of prompt injection (hidden instructions meant to steer an AI). It does not remove that risk.
  • Simple pricing structure. ERIS uses one licence and one price per user.

Whether a deployment meets the EU AI Act, GDPR (the EU data protection law), NIS2 or DORA (the EU rules on digital resilience in finance) depends on the use case and is assessed per deployment. ERIS does not make a company compliant.

Local AI has costs of its own. It needs suitable hardware, usually a GPU (graphics processing unit) server, and its speed depends on that hardware. Running it costs hardware, maintenance and updates. The local model reads and searches company documents. It is not trained on them.

Which one should you pick

You need bookkeeping, VAT work, payroll or industry ERP running now. Pick Exact Online. It is in use today, it covers finance, ERP, CRM and HR in one product, and ERIS's finance and HR modules are not part of its beta.

Your accountant already works with you in Exact Online. Stay with Exact Online. According to its website it is built for both companies and accountants, with specific editions for accounting firms.

Your company data may not go to outside cloud or AI providers, and you want one system with an AI assistant across meetings, tasks, documents and sales. Look at ERIS. It is built for that case, on your own servers or on Upward's own servers in the Netherlands, always with a local AI model. You need to be able to wait for the release in January 2027, or join the beta from November 2026.

You want both. Some companies may keep Exact Online for finance today and look at ERIS for meetings, tasks, documents and sales. Ready-made connections between the two are not stated on upwardtech.nl. Upward Technologies builds custom modules, agents and knowledge bases as projects, so ask whether your case fits. More about ERIS is on the ERIS product page.

FAQ

Do I need an in-house IT team to run ERIS on my own server?

Not necessarily. A company without its own IT team can choose to have ERIS hosted by Upward on its own servers in the Netherlands. Running ERIS on your own premises costs hardware, maintenance and updates, so plan who will take care of those before you choose that option.

What hardware do I need to run ERIS with local AI?

Local AI needs suitable hardware, usually a GPU server. How much depends on the AI models a company chooses, and speed depends on that hardware. Existing servers are not always enough. A company that does not want to run its own hardware can have ERIS hosted by Upward on its own servers in the Netherlands.

Can ERIS connect to my webshop, industry software or accountant?

Ready-made connections to webshops, industry software or accounting packages are not stated on upwardtech.nl. What Upward Technologies does build are custom modules, agents and knowledge bases for a company, as projects that are billed separately. Ask Upward whether your situation fits such a project. Access is set per person: the ERIS Assistant is built to answer each person only from the data that person is allowed to open, and every question and AI action is logged.

Is ERIS for one computer or a whole office team?

ERIS is built to run for the whole company, on its own hardware or hosted by Upward on its own servers in the Netherlands. It is meant for companies of every size and is priced with one licence and one price per user. The details are on the ERIS product page.
